obtained.how: open-access PDF from the publisher (Limnetica, Asociación Ibérica de Limnología; the DOI resolves to it)

bibliography.note: Authors Eglantine Chappuis, Enric Ballesteros, Esperança Gacia; title as cited

claims.claim: Isoetids produce only 5–425 g DW m⁻² yr⁻¹ (Chappuis et al. 2016, citing a review)
claims.quote: Their annual productivity has been described to range from 5 to 425 g DW/m2
claims.conditions: annual productivity of isoetids, from the review of Madsen, Olesen & Bagger 2002 (Aquatic Botany 73: 351–371); attributed to low biomass and low leaf turnover
claims.note: the review is Madsen et al. 2002; cite as 'Madsen et al. 2002, via Chappuis et al. 2016'

claims.claim: against 300–1,500 for other submerged plants (Chappuis et al. 2016, citing a review)
claims.quote: similar to the range described for other submerged species of 300-1500 g
claims.conditions: g DW m⁻² yr⁻¹, 'Madsen et al., 2002 and references therein'; Fig. 4 compares NPP across macrophyte groups

claims.quote: Plant density started as low as 1242 plants/m2, ended up with 2663 plants/m2
claims.conditions: Baciver pool, a ~20 m² semipermanent pond beside Lake Baciver at 2,120 m in the Spanish Pyrenees, frozen half the year; density over the growing seasons of 1988–1989 (mean 1,948.9 plants/m²); water about 50 cm deep through summer and autumn 1988, the pool dried in late July 1989
claims.note: a tiny alpine pool, not a lake littoral; the pool no longer exists (Lake Baciver was dammed after the fieldwork)

notes: Other values: I. echinospora leaf production 38.7 g DW m⁻² yr⁻¹ submerged (1988) and 49.3 with two months' emersion (1989), mean 44.0 (17.6 g C); I. delilei in a Mediterranean temporary pool 676.7 g DW m⁻² yr⁻¹; neighbouring Lake Baciver's I. lacustris 75 g DW m⁻² yr⁻¹ at −0.8 m (Gacia & Ballesteros 1994); underground production adds 30–50 % of the total for I. lacustris (Gacia & Ballesteros 1994). Only the bibliography's missing issue number makes this 'corrected'; every claim checks.
